project_type: Static HTML/JS website for insurance products
verification_instructions: Open mccp.html in browser, verify hook sentence at top, Dr. Sanjay Tolani quote in middle, 200 Juta option in calculator dropdown, calculator returns correct values for 200 Juta UP
setup_instructions: No setup needed - static HTML/JS files
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages. PDF extraction not possible. Premium data for 200 Juta must be derived mathematically from existing data (premiums scale linearly with UP - verified with 0% mismatch rate across 837 entries).
key_patterns: Premium data stored as single-line JS variable in mccp-premi.js with format: var MCCP_PREMIUM_DATA = {"plan|gender|age|mpp": {"0.5M": "value", "1M": "value", ...}}. Keys: plan (1 or 2), gender (pria/wanita), age (0-60), mpp (10/15/20/RP). UP values: 0.5M, 1M, 1.5M, 2M, 2.5M, 5M, 10M. Page uses inline CSS in <style> block, inline JS at bottom. Sections: Hero, Product Info, Plan Comparison, Premium Table, Calculator, Medical Requirements, FAQ, CTA.
directory_structure: public/pages/ - HTML pages, public/assets/ - JS/CSS assets, Source/MCCP/ - source PDFs for MCCP product
